arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ كٓهيعٓصٓ
transliteration: Kaaaf-Haa-Yaa-'Ayyyn-Saaad

translations.en.sahih: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.
translations.en.pickthall: Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad.
translations.en.yusufali: Kaf. Ha. Ya. 'Ain. Sad.
translations.id.indonesian: Kaaf Haa Yaa 'Ain Shaad.

arabic: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
transliteration: Zikru rahmati Rabbika 'abdahoo Zakariyya

translations.en.sahih: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
translations.en.pickthall: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.
translations.en.yusufali: (This is) a recital of the Mercy of thy Lord to His servant Zakariya.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yang dibacakan ini adalah) penjelasan tentang rahmat Tuhan kamu kepada hamba-Nya, Zakaria,

arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا
transliteration: Iz naadaa Rabbahoo nidaaa'an khafiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
translations.en.pickthall: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! he cried to his Lord in secret,
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu tatkala ia berdoa kepada Tuhannya dengan suara yang lembut.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi innee wahanal'azmu minnee washta'alar raasu shaibanw wa lam akum bidu'aaa'ika Rabbi shaqiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
translations.en.pickthall: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: Praying: "O my Lord! infirm indeed are my bones, and the hair of my head doth glisten with grey: but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to Thee!
translations.id.indonesian: Ia berkata "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya tulangku telah lemah dan kepalaku telah ditumbuhi uban, dan aku belum pernah kecewa dalam berdoa kepada Engkau, ya Tuhanku.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa innee khiftul mawaa liya minw waraaa'ee wa kaana tim ra atee 'aairan fahab lee mil ladunka waliyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor
translations.en.yusufali: "Now I fear (what) my relatives (and colleagues) (will do) after me: but my wife is barren: so give me an heir as from Thyself,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya aku khawatir terhadap mawaliku sepeninggalku, sedang isteriku adalah seorang yang mandul, maka anugerahilah aku dari sisi Engkau seorang putera,

arabic: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا
transliteration: Yarisunee wa yarisu min aali Ya'qoob, waj'alhu Rabbi radiyya

translations.en.sahih: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
translations.en.pickthall: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).
translations.en.yusufali: "(One that) will (truly) represent me, and represent the posterity of Jacob; and make him, O my Lord! one with whom Thou art well-pleased!"
translations.id.indonesian: yang akan mewarisi aku dan mewarisi sebahagian keluarga Ya'qub; dan jadikanlah ia, ya Tuhanku, seorang yang diridhai".

arabic: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا
transliteration: Yaa Zakariyyaaa innaa nubashshiruka bighulaami nismuhoo Yahyaa lam naj'al lahoo min qablu samiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
translations.en.pickthall: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).
translations.en.yusufali: (His prayer was answered): "O Zakariya! We give thee good news of a son: His name shall be Yahya: on none by that name have We conferred distinction before."
translations.id.indonesian: Hai Zakaria, sesungguhnya Kami memberi kabar gembira kepadamu akan (beroleh) seorang anak yang namanya Yahya, yang sebelumnya Kami belum pernah menciptakan orang yang serupa dengan dia.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa kaanatim ra atee aaqiranw wa qad balaghtu minal kibari 'itiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren and I have grown quite decrepit from old age?"
translations.id.indonesian: Zakaria berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, bagaimana akan ada anak bagiku, padahal isteriku adalah seorang yang mandul dan aku (sendiri) sesungguhnya sudah mencapai umur yang sangat tua".

arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
transliteration: Qaala kazaalika qaala Rabbuka huwa 'alaiya haiyinunw wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku shai'aa

translations.en.sahih: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "
translations.en.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "So (it will be) thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: I did indeed create thee before, when thou hadst been nothing!'"
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhan berfirman: "Demikianlah". Tuhan berfirman: "Hal itu adalah mudah bagi-Ku; dan sesunguhnya telah Aku ciptakan kamu sebelum itu, padahal kamu (di waktu itu) belum ada sama sekali".

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayah; qaala Aayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasa layaalin sawiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.
translations.en.yusufali: (Zakariya) said: "O my Lord! give me a Sign." "Thy Sign," was the answer, "Shall be that thou shalt speak to no man for three nights, although thou art not dumb."
translations.id.indonesian: Zakaria berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, berilah aku suatu tanda". Tuhan berfirman: "Tanda bagimu ialah bahwa kamu tidak dapat bercakap-cakap dengan manusia selama tiga malam, padahal kamu sehat".

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee minal mihraabi fa-awhaaa ilaihim an sabbihoo bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
translations.en.pickthall: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.
translations.en.yusufali: So Zakariya came out to his people from him chamber: He told them by signs to celebrate Allah's praises in the morning and in the evening.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka ia keluar dari mihrab menuju kaumnya, lalu ia memberi isyarat kepada mereka; hendaklah kamu bertasbih di waktu pagi dan petang.

arabic: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Yaa Yahyaa khuzil Kitaaba biquwwatinw wa aatainaahul hukma saiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
translations.en.pickthall: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,
translations.en.yusufali: (To his son came the command): "O Yahya! take hold of the Book with might": and We gave him Wisdom even as a youth,
translations.id.indonesian: Hai Yahya, ambillah Al Kitab (Taurat) itu dengan sungguh-sungguh. Dan kami berikan kepadanya hikmah selagi ia masih kanak-kanak,

arabic: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa hanaanam mil ladunnaa wa zakaatanw wa kaana taqiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
translations.en.pickthall: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,
translations.en.yusufali: And piety (for all creatures) as from Us, and purity: He was devout,
translations.id.indonesian: dan rasa belas kasihan yang mendalam dari sisi Kami dan kesucian (dan dosa). Dan ia adalah seorang yang bertakwa,

arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa barram biwaalidayhi wa lam yakum jabbaaran 'asiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
translations.en.pickthall: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.
translations.en.yusufali: And kind to his parents, and he was not overbearing or rebellious.
translations.id.indonesian: dan seorang yang berbakti kepada kedua orang tuanya, dan bukanlah ia orang yang sombong lagi durhaka.

arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa salaamun 'alaihi yawma wulida wa yawma yamootu wa yawma yub'asu haiyaa

translations.en.sahih: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
translations.en.pickthall: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!
translations.en.yusufali: So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!
translations.id.indonesian: Kesejahteraan atas dirinya pada hari ia dilahirkan dan pada hari ia meninggal dan pada hari ia dibangkitkan hidup kembali.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Marya; izin tabazat min ahlihaa makaanan shariqyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,
translations.en.yusufali: Relate in the Book (the story of) Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place in the East.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ceritakanlah (kisah) Maryam di dalam Al Quran, yaitu ketika ia menjauhkan diri dari keluarganya ke suatu tempat di sebelah timur,

arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fattakhazat min doonihim hijaaban fa arsalnaaa ilaihaa roohanaa fatamassala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
translations.en.pickthall: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.
translations.en.yusufali: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent her our angel, and he appeared before her as a man in all respects.
translations.id.indonesian: maka ia mengadakan tabir (yang melindunginya) dari mereka; lalu Kami mengutus roh Kami kepadanya, maka ia menjelma di hadapannya (dalam bentuk) manusia yang sempurna.

arabic: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaalat inneee a'oozu bir Rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."
translations.en.pickthall: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.
translations.en.yusufali: She said: "I seek refuge from thee to (Allah) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah."
translations.id.indonesian: Maryam berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku berlindung dari padamu kepada Tuhan Yang Maha pemurah, jika kamu seorang yang bertakwa".

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala innamaa ana rasoolu Rabbiki li ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Nay, I am only a messenger from thy Lord, (to announce) to thee the gift of a holy son.
translations.id.indonesian: Ia (jibril) berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku ini hanyalah seorang utusan Tuhanmu, untuk memberimu seorang anak laki-laki yang suci".

arabic: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaalat anna yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa lam yamsasnee bashrunw wa lam aku baghiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
translations.en.pickthall: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?
translations.en.yusufali: She said: "How shall I have a son, seeing that no man has touched me, and I am not unchaste?"
translations.id.indonesian: Maryam berkata: "Bagaimana akan ada bagiku seorang anak laki-laki, sedang tidak pernah seorang manusiapun menyentuhku dan aku bukan (pula) seorang pezina!"

arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki huwa 'alaiya yaiyimunw wa linaj 'alahooo Aayatal linnaasi wa rahmatam minnaa; wa kaana amram maqdiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
translations.en.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "So (it will be): Thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: and (We wish) to appoint him as a Sign unto men and a Mercy from Us': It is a matter (so) decreed."
translations.id.indonesian: Jibril berkata: "Demikianlah". Tuhanmu berfirman: "Hal itu adalah mudah bagi-Ku; dan agar dapat Kami menjadikannya suatu tanda bagi manusia dan sebagai rahmat dari Kami; dan hal itu adalah suatu perkara yang sudah diputuskan".

arabic: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fahamalat hu fantabazat bihee makaanan qasiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
translations.en.pickthall: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.
translations.en.yusufali: So she conceived him, and she retired with him to a remote place.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Maryam mengandungnya, lalu ia menyisihkan diri dengan kandungannya itu ke tempat yang jauh.

arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fa ajaaa 'ahal makhaadu ilaa jiz'in nakhlati qaalat yaa laitanee mittu qabla haazaa wa kuntu nasyam mansiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
translations.en.pickthall: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!
translations.en.yusufali: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree: She cried (in her anguish): "Ah! would that I had died before this! would that I had been a thing forgotten and out of sight!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka rasa sakit akan melahirkan anak memaksa ia (bersandar) pada pangkal pohon kurma, dia berkata: "Aduhai, alangkah baiknya aku mati sebelum ini, dan aku menjadi barang yang tidak berarti, lagi dilupakan".

arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaan allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala Rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa

translations.en.sahih: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
translations.en.pickthall: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,
translations.en.yusufali: But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee;
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Jibril menyerunya dari tempat yang rendah: "Janganlah kamu bersedih hati, sesungguhnya Tuhanmu telah menjadikan anak sungai di bawahmu.

arabic: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa huzzeee ilaiki bijiz 'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
translations.en.pickthall: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.
translations.en.yusufali: "And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree: It will let fall fresh ripe dates upon thee.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan goyanglah pangkal pohon kurma itu ke arahmu, niscaya pohon itu akan menggugurkan buah kurma yang masak kepadamu,

arabic: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fakulee washrabee wa qarree 'ainaa; fa immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
translations.en.pickthall: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.
translations.en.yusufali: "So eat and drink and cool (thine) eye. And if thou dost see any man, say, 'I have vowed a fast to (Allah) Most Gracious, and this day will I enter into not talk with any human being'"
translations.id.indonesian: maka makan, minum dan bersenang hatilah kamu. Jika kamu melihat seorang manusia, maka katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku telah bernazar berpuasa untuk Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, maka aku tidak akan berbicara dengan seorang manusiapun pada hari ini".

arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fa atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa Maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa

translations.en.sahih: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
translations.en.pickthall: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.
translations.en.yusufali: At length she brought the (babe) to her people, carrying him (in her arms). They said: "O Mary! truly an amazing thing hast thou brought!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Maryam membawa anak itu kepada kaumnya dengan menggendongnya. Kaumnya berkata: "Hai Maryam, sesungguhnya kamu telah melakukan sesuatu yang amat mungkar.

arabic: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
transliteration: Yaaa ukkhta Haaroona maa kaana abokim ra-a saw'inw wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
translations.en.pickthall: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.
translations.en.yusufali: "O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of evil, nor thy mother a woman unchaste!"
translations.id.indonesian: Hai saudara perempuan Harun, ayahmu sekali-kali bukanlah seorang yang jahat dan ibumu sekali-kali bukanlah seorang pezina",

arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fa ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
translations.en.pickthall: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?
translations.en.yusufali: But she pointed to the babe. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"
translations.id.indonesian: maka Maryam menunjuk kepada anaknya. Mereka berkata: "Bagaimana kami akan berbicara dengan anak kecil yang masih di dalam ayunan?"

arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala innee 'abdullaahi aataaniyal Kitaaba wa ja'alanee Nabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
translations.en.pickthall: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "I am indeed a servant of Allah: He hath given me revelation and made me a prophet;
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Isa: "Sesungguhnya aku ini hamba Allah, Dia memberiku Al Kitab (Injil) dan Dia menjadikan aku seorang nabi,

arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis Salaati waz Zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa

translations.en.sahih: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
translations.en.pickthall: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,
translations.en.yusufali: "And He hath made me blessed wheresoever I be, and hath enjoined on me Prayer and Charity as long as I live;
translations.id.indonesian: dan Dia menjadikan aku seorang yang diberkati di mana saja aku berada, dan Dia memerintahkan kepadaku (mendirikan) shalat dan (menunaikan) zakat selama aku hidup;

arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa barram biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
translations.en.pickthall: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
translations.en.yusufali: "(He) hath made me kind to my mother, and not overbearing or miserable;
translations.id.indonesian: dan berbakti kepada ibuku, dan Dia tidak menjadikan aku seorang yang sombong lagi celaka.

arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
transliteration: Wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulittu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'asu baiyaa

translations.en.sahih: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
translations.en.pickthall: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
translations.en.yusufali: "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kesejahteraan semoga dilimpahkan kepadaku, pada hari aku dilahirkan, pada hari aku meninggal dan pada hari aku dibangkitkan hidup kembali".

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
transliteration: Zaalika 'Eesab-nu Marya; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon

translations.en.sahih: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
translations.en.pickthall: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.
translations.en.yusufali: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute.
translations.id.indonesian: Itulah Isa putera Maryam, yang mengatakan perkataan yang benar, yang mereka berbantah-bantahan tentang kebenarannya.

arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
transliteration: Maa kaana lillaahi ai yattakhiza minw waladin Subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakoon

translations.en.sahih: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
translations.en.pickthall: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
translations.en.yusufali: It is not befitting to (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glory be to Him! when He determines a matter, He only says to it, "Be", and it is.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak layak bagi Allah mempunyai anak, Maha Suci Dia. Apabila Dia telah menetapkan sesuatu, maka Dia hanya berkata kepadanya: "Jadilah", maka jadilah ia.

arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Wa innal laaha Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord: Him therefore serve ye: this is a Way that is straight.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Allah adalah Tuhanku dan Tuhanmu, maka sembahIah Dia oleh kamu sekalian. Ini adalah jalan yang lurus.

arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
transliteration: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mim mashhadi Yawmin 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
translations.en.pickthall: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.
translations.en.yusufali: But the sects differ among themselves: and woe to the unbelievers because of the (coming) Judgment of a Momentous Day!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berselisihlah golongan-golongan (yang ada) di antara mereka. Maka kecelakaanlah bagi orang-orang kafir pada waktu menyaksikan hari yang besar.

arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
transliteration: Asmi' bihim wa absir Yawma yaatoonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
translations.en.pickthall: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
translations.en.yusufali: How plainly will they see and hear, the Day that they will appear before Us! but the unjust today are in error manifest!
translations.id.indonesian: Alangkah terangnya pendengaran mereka dan alangkah tajamnya penglihatan mereka pada hari mereka datang kepada Kami. Tetapi orang-orang yang zalim pada hari ini (di dunia) berada dalam kesesatan yang nyata.

arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Wa anzirhum Yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; wa hum fee ghaflatinw wa hum laa yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
translations.en.pickthall: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.
translations.en.yusufali: But warn them of the Day of Distress, when the matter will be determined: for (behold,) they are negligent and they do not believe!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berilah mereka peringatan tentang hari penyesalan, (yaitu) ketika segala perkara telah diputus. Dan mereka dalam kelalaian dan mereka tidak (pula) beriman.

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
transliteration: Innaa NNahnu narisul arda wa man 'alaihaa wa ilainaa yurja'oon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.
translations.en.yusufali: It is We Who will inherit the earth, and all beings thereon: to Us will they all be returned.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami mewarisi bumi dan semua orang-orang yang ada di atasnya, dan hanya kepada Kamilah mereka dikembalikan.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.
translations.en.yusufali: (Also mention in the Book (the story of) Abraham: He was a man of Truth, a prophet.
translations.id.indonesian: Ceritakanlah (Hai Muhammad) kisah Ibrahim di dalam Al Kitab (Al Quran) ini. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang sangat membenarkan lagi seorang Nabi.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi yaaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa

translations.en.sahih: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
translations.en.pickthall: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, he said to his father: "O my father! why worship that which heareth not and seeth not, and can profit thee nothing?
translations.id.indonesian: Ingatlah ketika ia berkata kepada bapaknya; "Wahai bapakku, mengapa kamu menyembah sesuatu yang tidak mendengar, tidak melihat dan tidak dapat menolong kamu sedikitpun?

arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
transliteration: Yaaa abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam yaatika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan Sawiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
translations.en.pickthall: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.
translations.en.yusufali: "O my father! to me hath come knowledge which hath not reached thee: so follow me: I will guide thee to a way that is even and straight.
translations.id.indonesian: Wahai bapakku, sesungguhnya telah datang kepadaku sebahagian ilmu pengetahuan yang tidak datang kepadamu, maka ikutilah aku, niscaya aku akan menunjukkan kepadamu jalan yang lurus.

arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
transliteration: Yaaa abati laa ta'budish Shaitaana innash Shaitaana kaana lir Rahmaani 'asiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
translations.en.pickthall: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.
translations.en.yusufali: "O my father! serve not Satan: for Satan is a rebel against (Allah) Most Gracious.
translations.id.indonesian: Wahai bapakku, janganlah kamu menyembah syaitan. Sesungguhnya syaitan itu durhaka kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah.

arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
transliteration: Yaaa abati innee akhaafu ai yamssaka 'azaabum minar Rahmaani fatakoona lish Shaitaani waliyyaa

translations.en.sahih: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
translations.en.pickthall: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.
translations.en.yusufali: "O my father! I fear lest a Penalty afflict thee from (Allah) Most Gracious, so that thou become to Satan a friend."
translations.id.indonesian: Wahai bapakku, sesungguhnya aku khawatir bahwa kamu akan ditimpa azab dari Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, maka kamu menjadi kawan bagi syaitan".

arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa Ibraaheemu la 'il lam tantahi la arjumannaka wahjumee maliyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!
translations.en.yusufali: (The father) replied: "Dost thou hate my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will indeed stone thee: Now get away from me for a good long while!"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata bapaknya: "Bencikah kamu kepada tuhan-tuhanku, hai Ibrahim? Jika kamu tidak berhenti, maka niscaya kamu akan kurajam, dan tinggalkanlah aku buat waktu yang lama".

arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
transliteration: Qaala salaamun 'alaika sa astaghfiru laka Rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.
translations.en.yusufali: Abraham said: "Peace be on thee: I will pray to my Lord for thy forgiveness: for He is to me Most Gracious.
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Ibrahim: "Semoga keselamatan dilimpahkan kepadamu, aku akan memintakan ampun bagimu kepada Tuhanku. Sesungguhnya Dia sangat baik kepadaku.

arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonil laahi wa ad'o Rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i Rabbee shaqiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
translations.en.pickthall: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
translations.en.yusufali: "And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku akan menjauhkan diri darimu dan dari apa yang kamu seru selain Allah, dan aku akan berdoa kepada Tuhanku, mudah-mudahan aku tidak akan kecewa dengan berdoa kepada Tuhanku".

arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Falamma' tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa wa ya'qoob, wa kullan ja'alnaa Nabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
translations.en.pickthall: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.
translations.en.yusufali: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka ketika Ibrahim sudah menjauhkan diri dari mereka dan dari apa yang mereka sembah selain Allah, Kami anugerahkan kepadanya Ishak, dan Ya'qub. Dan masing-masingnya Kami angkat menjadi nabi.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
translations.en.pickthall: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.
translations.en.yusufali: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami anugerahkan kepada mereka sebagian dari rahmat Kami dan Kami jadikan mereka buah tutur yang baik lagi tinggi.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
translations.en.yusufali: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ceritakanlah (hai Muhammad kepada mereka), kisah Musa di dalam Al Kitab (Al Quran) ini. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang dipilih dan seorang rasul dan nabi.

arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa naadainaahu min jaanibit Tooril aimani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
translations.en.pickthall: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.
translations.en.yusufali: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah memanggilnya dari sebelah kanan gunung Thur dan Kami telah mendekatkannya kepada Kami di waktu dia munajat (kepada Kami).

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu Haaroona Nabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
translations.en.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).
translations.en.yusufali: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah menganugerahkan kepadanya sebagian rahmat Kami, yaitu saudaranya, Harun menjadi seorang nabi.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
translations.en.yusufali: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ceritakanlah (hai Muhammad kepada mereka) kisah Ismail (yang tersebut) di dalam Al Quran. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang benar janjinya, dan dia adalah seorang rasul dan nabi.

arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa kaana yaamuru ahlahoo bis Salaati waz zakaati wa kaana 'inda Rabbihee mardiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
translations.en.pickthall: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ia menyuruh ahlinya untuk bersembahyang dan menunaikan zakat, dan ia adalah seorang yang diridhai di sisi Tuhannya.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;
translations.en.yusufali: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ceritakanlah (hai Muhammad kepada mereka, kisah) Idris (yang tersebut) di dalam Al Quran. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang sangat membenarkan dan seorang nabi.

arabic: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
transliteration: Wa rafa'naahu makaanan 'aliyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And We raised him to a high station.
translations.en.pickthall: And We raised him to high station.
translations.en.yusufali: And We raised him to a lofty station.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah mengangkatnya ke martabat yang tinggi.

arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan Nabiyyeena min zurriyyati Aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a Noohinw wa min zurriyyati Ibraaheema wa Israaa'eela wa mimman hadainaa wajta bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatur Rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw wa bukiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
translations.en.pickthall: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.
translations.en.yusufali: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka itu adalah orang-orang yang telah diberi nikmat oleh Allah, yaitu para nabi dari keturunan Adam, dan dari orang-orang yang Kami angkat bersama Nuh, dan dari keturunan Ibrahim dan Israil, dan dari orang-orang yang telah Kami beri petunjuk dan telah Kami pilih. Apabila dibacakan ayat-ayat Allah Yang Maha Pemurah kepada mereka, maka mereka menyungkur dengan bersujud dan menangis.

arabic: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
transliteration: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us Salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyaa

translations.en.sahih: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
translations.en.pickthall: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.
translations.en.yusufali: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction,-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka datanglah sesudah mereka, pengganti (yang jelek) yang menyia-nyiakan shalat dan memperturutkan hawa nafsunya, maka mereka kelak akan menemui kesesatan,

arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
transliteration: Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shai'aa

translations.en.sahih: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
translations.en.pickthall: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -
translations.en.yusufali: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least,-
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali orang yang bertaubat, beriman dan beramal saleh, maka mereka itu akan masuk surga dan tidak dianiaya (dirugikan) sedikitpun,

arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
transliteration: Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar Rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo maatiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
translations.en.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -
translations.en.yusufali: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass.
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu surga 'Adn yang telah dijanjikan oleh Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah kepada hamba-hamba-Nya, sekalipun (surga itu) tidak nampak. Sesungguhnya janji Allah itu pasti akan ditepati.

arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
transliteration: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
translations.en.pickthall: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
translations.en.yusufali: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak mendengar perkataan yang tak berguna di dalam surga, kecuali ucapan salam. Bagi mereka rezekinya di surga itu tiap-tiap pagi dan petang.

arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
transliteration: Tilkal jannatul latee oorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
translations.en.pickthall: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
translations.en.yusufali: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil.
translations.id.indonesian: Itulah surga yang akan Kami wariskan kepada hamba-hamba Kami yang selalu bertakwa.

arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi amri Rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa baina zaalik; wa maa kaana Rabbuka nasiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
translations.en.pickthall: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
translations.en.yusufali: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah kami (Jibril) turun, kecuali dengan perintah Tuhanmu. Kepunyaan-Nya-lah apa-apa yang ada di hadapan kita, apa-apa yang ada di belakang kita dan apa-apa yang ada di antara keduanya, dan tidaklah Tuhanmu lupa.

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
transliteration: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa fa'bud hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?
translations.en.yusufali: "Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He?"
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhan (yang menguasai) langit dan bumi dan apa-apa yang ada di antara keduanya, maka sembahlah Dia dan berteguh hatilah dalam beribadat kepada-Nya. Apakah kamu mengetahui ada seorang yang sama dengan Dia (yang patut disembah)?

arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
transliteration: Wa yaqoolul insaanu 'aizaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa

translations.en.sahih: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
translations.en.pickthall: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
translations.en.yusufali: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berkata manusia: "Betulkah apabila aku telah mati, bahwa aku sungguh-sungguh akan dibangkitkan menjadi hidup kembali?"

arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
transliteration: awalaa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shai'aa

translations.en.sahih: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
translations.en.pickthall: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
translations.en.yusufali: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidakkah manusia itu memikirkan bahwa sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakannya dahulu, sedang ia tidak ada sama sekali?

arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
transliteration: Fawa Rabbika lanahshu rannahum wash shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
translations.en.pickthall: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.
translations.en.yusufali: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell;
translations.id.indonesian: Demi Tuhanmu, sesungguhnya akan Kami bangkitkan mereka bersama syaitan, kemudian akan Kami datangkan mereka ke sekeliling Jahannam dengan berlutut.

arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
transliteration: Summa lananzi 'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar Rahmaani 'itiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
translations.en.yusufali: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian pasti akan Kami tarik dari tiap-tiap golongan siapa di antara mereka yang sangat durhaka kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah.

arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
transliteration: Summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa

translations.en.sahih: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
translations.en.pickthall: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.
translations.en.yusufali: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kemudian Kami sungguh lebih mengetahui orang-orang yang seharusnya dimasukkan ke dalam neraka.

arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa im minkum illaa waa riduhaa; kaana 'alaa Rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
translations.en.pickthall: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidak ada seorangpun dari padamu, melainkan mendatangi neraka itu. Hal itu bagi Tuhanmu adalah suatu kemestian yang sudah ditetapkan.

arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
transliteration: Summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw wa nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
translations.en.yusufali: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami akan menyelamatkan orang-orang yang bertakwa dan membiarkan orang-orang yang zalim di dalam neraka dalam keadaan berlutut.

arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
transliteration: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw wa ahsanu nadiyyaa

translations.en.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
translations.en.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?
translations.en.yusufali: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila dibacakan kepada mereka ayat-ayat Kami yang terang (maksudnya), niscaya orang-orang yang kafir berkata kepada orang-orang yang beriman: "Manakah di antara kedua golongan (kafir dan mukmin) yang lebih baik tempat tinggalnya dan lebih indah tempat pertemuan(nya)?"

arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا
transliteration: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw wa ri'yaa

translations.en.sahih: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
translations.en.pickthall: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!
translations.en.yusufali: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye?
translations.id.indonesian: Berapa banyak umat yang telah Kami binasakan sebelum mereka, sedang mereka adalah lebih bagus alat rumah tangganya dan lebih sedap di pandang mata.

arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
transliteration: Qul man kaana fidda laalati falyamdud lahur Rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba wa immas Saa'ata fasa ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw wa ad'afu jundaa

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
translations.en.pickthall: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces!
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Barang siapa yang berada di dalam kesesatan, maka biarlah Tuhan yang Maha Pemurah memperpanjang tempo baginya; sehingga apabila mereka telah melihat apa yang diancamkan kepadanya, baik siksa maupun kiamat, maka mereka akan mengetahui siapa yang lebih jelek kedudukannya dan lebih lemah penolong-penolongnya".

arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
transliteration: Wa yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw wa khairum maraddaa

translations.en.sahih: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
translations.en.pickthall: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
translations.en.yusufali: "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Allah akan menambah petunjuk kepada mereka yang telah mendapat petunjuk. Dan amal-amal saleh yang kekal itu lebih baik pahalanya di sisi Tuhanmu dan lebih baik kesudahannya.

arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
transliteration: Afara'aytal lazee kafara bi Aayaatinaa wa qaala la oota yanna maalanw wa waladaa

translations.en.sahih: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?
translations.en.yusufali: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kamu telah melihat orang yang kafir kepada ayat-ayat Kami dan ia mengatakan: "Pasti aku akan diberi harta dan anak".

arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
transliteration: Attala'al ghaiba amitta khaza'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa

translations.en.sahih: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
translations.en.pickthall: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?
translations.en.yusufali: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious?
translations.id.indonesian: Adakah ia melihat yang ghaib atau ia telah membuat perjanjian di sisi Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah?,

arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
transliteration: Kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa

translations.en.sahih: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment.
translations.id.indonesian: sekali-kali tidak, Kami akan menulis apa yang ia katakan, dan benar-benar Kami akan memperpanjang azab untuknya,

arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
transliteration: Wa narisuhoo maa yaqoolu wa yaateenaa fardaa

translations.en.sahih: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
translations.en.pickthall: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).
translations.en.yusufali: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami akan mewarisi apa yang ia katakan itu, dan ia akan datang kepada Kami dengan seorang diri.

arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
transliteration: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa

translations.en.sahih: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
translations.en.pickthall: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.
translations.en.yusufali: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka telah mengambil sembahan-sembahan selain Allah, agar sembahan-sembahan itu menjadi pelindung bagi mereka,

arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
transliteration: Kallaa; sa yakfuroona bi'ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona 'alaihim diddaa

translations.en.sahih: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
translations.en.yusufali: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them.
translations.id.indonesian: sekali-kali tidak. Kelak mereka (sembahan-sembahan) itu akan mengingkari penyembahan (pengikut-pengikutnya) terhadapnya, dan mereka (sembahan-sembahan) itu akan menjadi musuh bagi mereka.

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
transliteration: Alam tara annaaa arsalnash Shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa

translations.en.sahih: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
translations.en.pickthall: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury?
translations.id.indonesian: Tidakkah kamu lihat, bahwasanya Kami telah mengirim syaitan-syaitan itu kepada orang-orang kafir untuk menghasung mereka berbuat maksiat dengan sungguh-sungguh?,

arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
transliteration: Falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na 'uddu lahum 'addaa

translations.en.sahih: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
translations.en.pickthall: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
translations.en.yusufali: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days).
translations.id.indonesian: maka janganlah kamu tergesa-gesa memintakan siksa terhadap mereka, karena sesungguhnya Kami hanya menghitung datangnya (hari siksaan) untuk mereka dengan perhitungan yang teliti.

arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
transliteration: Yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar Rahmaani wafdaa

translations.en.sahih: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.
translations.en.yusufali: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours,
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah) hari (ketika) Kami mengumpulkan orang-orang yang takwa kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah sebagai perutusan yang terhormat,

arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
transliteration: Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ilaa Jahannama wirdaa

translations.en.sahih: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
translations.en.pickthall: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
translations.en.yusufali: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami akan menghalau orang-orang yang durhaka ke neraka Jahannam dalam keadaan dahaga.

arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
transliteration: Laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ta illaa manittakhaza 'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa

translations.en.sahih: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
translations.en.pickthall: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak berhak mendapat syafa'at kecuali orang yang telah mengadakan perjanjian di sisi Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah.

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
transliteration: Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladaa

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.
translations.en.yusufali: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah mengambil (mempunyai) anak".

arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
transliteration: Laqad ji'tum shai'an iddaa

translations.en.sahih: You have done an atrocious thing.
translations.en.pickthall: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing
translations.en.yusufali: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kamu telah mendatangkan sesuatu perkara yang sangat mungkar,

arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
transliteration: Takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaq qul ardu wa takhirrul jibaalu haddaa

translations.en.sahih: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
translations.en.pickthall: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
translations.en.yusufali: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
translations.id.indonesian: hampir-hampir langit pecah karena ucapan itu, dan bumi belah, dan gunung-gunung runtuh,

arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
transliteration: An da'aw lir Rahmaani waladaa

translations.en.sahih: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
translations.en.pickthall: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,
translations.en.yusufali: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious.
translations.id.indonesian: karena mereka mendakwakan Allah Yang Maha Pemurah mempunyai anak.

arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
transliteration: Wa maa yambaghee lir Rahmaani ai yattakhiza waladaa

translations.en.sahih: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
translations.en.pickthall: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
translations.en.yusufali: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidak layak bagi Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah mengambil (mempunyai) anak.

arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
transliteration: In kullu man fis samaawaati wal ardi illaaa aatir Rahmaani 'abdaa

translations.en.sahih: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
translations.en.pickthall: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
translations.en.yusufali: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada seorangpun di langit dan di bumi, kecuali akan datang kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah selaku seorang hamba.

arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
transliteration: Laqad ahsaahum wa addahum 'addaa

translations.en.sahih: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
translations.en.pickthall: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
translations.en.yusufali: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Allah telah menentukan jumlah mereka dan menghitung mereka dengan hitungan yang teliti.

arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
transliteration: Wa kulluhum aateehi Yawmal Qiyaamati fardaa

translations.en.sahih: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
translations.en.pickthall: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
translations.en.yusufali: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tiap-tiap mereka akan datang kepada Allah pada hari kiamat dengan sendiri-sendiri.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا
transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati sa yaj'alu lahumur Rahmaanu wuddaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
translations.en.yusufali: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, kelak Allah Yang Maha Pemurah akan menanamkan dalam (hati) mereka rasa kasih sayang.

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
transliteration: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena wa tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa

translations.en.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
translations.en.pickthall: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
translations.en.yusufali: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran itu dengan bahasamu, agar kamu dapat memberi kabar gembira dengan Al Quran itu kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa, dan agar kamu memberi peringatan dengannya kepada kaum yang membangkang.

arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
transliteration: Wa kam ahlaknaa qabla hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa

translations.en.sahih: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
translations.en.pickthall: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?
translations.en.yusufali: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berapa banyak telah Kami binasakan umat-umat sebelum mereka. Adakah kamu melihat seorangpun dari mereka atau kamu dengar suara mereka yang samar-samar?
